text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Kiseki pulls off a magnificent wire-to-wire win!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Giving no chance to the closing speed of her classmates or older rivals! A brilliant wire-to-wire victory!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*......... How's that...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: How's THAT?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOAAAAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Kiseki-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way to the waiting room,
Vivlos was lying in wait for us.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
To think she'd really pull off a wire-to-wire win...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Bleehhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-cha... Ahh...
choice_data_list: Maybe I was just frustrated that I lost so completely to you
Maybe I was just frustrated that I lost to you so completely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold out a hand to stop Kiseki,
who was about to chase after Vivlos, and speak to her.
choice_data_list: That's just how perfect your run was.
That's just how perfect your run was.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Enough that even Vivlos, who was running alongside her, could tell?"
choice_data_list: Jealousy is the greatest compliment, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (...My strength has been recognized.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(In Vivlos, and in all the Umamusume around her.
In the hearts of all those girls who ran... I'll leave "me" behind.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (I ran a race that left a lasting impression! I did something so thrilling it'd make anyone jealous!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —If that's the case, then this time for sure!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Whyyyyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~!
Ai-chan was all over the main features of the magazine~~!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I know achieving the Triple Tiara
makes for a better headline!
I know that, but still...!
choice_data_list: Jealousy is the greatest compliment, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The miracle at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) was wonderful.
Even through my own eyes, that was undeniably true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, even so,
the public mood was being swept away by a single figure."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye-san!
Congratulations on achieving the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
We heard you're heading to the Japan Cup for your next race!
You're aiming to be number one in Japan!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because there are rivals in the Senior division I wish to compete against as well. ...Now, if you'll excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...And now I'm surrounded by reporters, too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...What about Ai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Even though Almond-chan is from the Tiara route,
she's walking a royal road that surpasses even the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To always be at the center of my generation,
to be an Umamusume who is praised forever and ever...!
choice_data_list: ...I can see why everyone praises her so much.
...I can see why everyone praises her so much.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ……Of course I did!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"She's fast. Exceptionally so.
And I won't lose to her!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Her mind and body are on a completely different level. Even at summer camp, without breaking a sweat,
she just coolly carried on training..."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh, it's so frustrating~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew! What on earth is up with her!?
That absolutely flawless rival of mine!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today will be an epic observation session!
Look forward to the new and improved me next week!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So I came up with a super special move, and
for the second Senior Autumn race, the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...The Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Wait, didn't Ai-chan say
she was going to run too? Just a moment ago...
choice_data_list: Yeah, the next one is the showdown right away.
Yeah, the showdown is coming up right next.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haah, what? It was just a dream...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap-tap-tap-tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, was it all just a dream?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa...!
Next, one more lap............!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(It's this late and she's still putting in the laps.
...A genius who works hard is the most troublesome kind.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(And she doesn't rest at all, like a cyborg.
Seriously, what can I even say...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, Ai-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After hearing from Kiseki, we hurriedly
transport Almond Eye to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Such intense heat...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you both very much
for bringing her all the way here."
choice_data_list: Not at all. So, about Almond Eye...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: If the fever doesn't go down, I will have her examined at a major hospital.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Still, this isn't the first time
I've collapsed with a fever, after all.
...Why, the summer training camp was quite an ordeal too.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Ai-chan.
You're not sweating at all...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Still, during the summer training camp,
Ai-chan wasn't sweating at all...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
"I think my body just doesn't sweat very easily.
Because of that, it's hard to release heat,
and my body temperature takes longer to drop."

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: Because it's a symptom that's hard for outsiders to notice, people tend to push past their limits before they realize it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ……My limit?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Does even Ai-chan have a "limit"?!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
My body is just like any ordinary Umamusume's!

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: ...If you push yourself too hard, collapsing is only to be expected.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: Especially after the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), she came to the nurse's office multiple times...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Because I wanted to win...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chan?!
Y-You're supposed to be resting in bed...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to win! I wanted to win!
Because Lala gets stronger with every single race!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And once the Triple Tiara is over,
with you, I—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to race against Kiseki-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to win.
In the Triple Tiara as well.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Even in a race with you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've wanted to win for so, so long...!
Ever since the Junior Class, always...!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to win, so...!
Of course I want to train...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………――Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: H-Hey! Almond Eye-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SPLAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Almond Eye grabbed the bowl of cold water beside her and poured it straight over her own head.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Once my fever goes down,
I can train again, right...?!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'm sorry, Sensei...
I'll wipe the wet floor, and...

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Agh, that's not what I'm worried about!
Almond Eye-san, you—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Um... Kiseki-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I'm going to defeat you! You, who came from the Triple Crown route and are hailed as the strongest right now!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even if you're the strongest, I will win!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...I have to win...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ai-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To keep Almond Eye from getting any more excited, Kiseki and I were both kicked out of the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...My heart is still unsettled.
After seeing a 'different' side of the rival I had always thought was utterly flawless."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
......I thought she was a refined Umamusume.
An elite, yet so refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And yet, she has a gritty side to her, too.
Putting in all that effort and obsession
just for that single desire to win...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pushing through with sheer willpower, just like—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Just like—.........!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: She's not my greatest enemy, nor my rival...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That is...—!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...No! No way!!
Ai-chan is the one person I absolutely refuse to lose to!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I... I will...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I want to be... the main character...!!
